Register Patient.description: Creates a new patient with an identifier and demographics.

Upsert Patient by Identifier.description: Creates a patient, or updates the existing one found by a search query.

Start a Visit.description: Opens a visit for a patient at a facility.

Create Encounter with Observations.description: Records a clinical encounter with its observations in one request.

Record Observation.description: Saves a single observation (e.g. a lab result) for a patient.

Add Patient Identifier.description: Adds another identifier (e.g. a national ID) to an existing patient.

Record Patient Allergy.description: Adds an allergy to a patient's record.

Update Person Demographics.description: Updates only the given fields on a person record.

Void Encounter.description: Voids (or purges) an encounter entered in error.

Search Patients.description: Searches patients by name or identifier.

Get Patient by UUID.description: Fetches a single patient as an object.

List Patient Encounters.description: Lists a patient's encounters, optionally filtered by type and date.

Get Observations for Concept.description: Fetches a patient's observations for one concept, e.g. all weights.

List Locations.description: Lists facilities/locations, e.g. to map facility codes to UUIDs.

List Concepts.description: Searches the concept dictionary by name.
